corrections.why: The final cab was an R-6 flat cab; the L-4 cab was the 1933 original, replaced in 1959.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com dates the R-6 cab on its concrete base to 1959; the Forest Lookouts page dates a cinder-block base and R-6 cab to 1957. The two also differ on the base material.

notes_for_editor: The brief's height_m of 3.0 is the 10-ft base, not a height to the cab floor, so no height fact was written; check whether the record should keep it. Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com differ on Bill Bates' years (firelookout.com: 1964-1968 with a relief question; Idaho listing: 1966-1968 with a relief entry), and they differ on Dave Garner's seasons; the story avoids both. A July 1958 Missoula item on the Forest Lookouts page describes a helicopter disabled while landing at 'Elkhorn Point lookout'; it may or may not be this site, so it is not used. The 1957 vs 1959 dating and the cinder-block vs concrete base are unresolved beyond the explanation above. The brief's kind 'two_story' matches the index's '2-Story cab'. No new photos added; the Idaho photos are credited to the Fire Lookout Museum without licence data.
